milestones.work: Hartmanis, J.; Stearns, R. E., On the computational complexity of algorithms, Transactions of the American Mathematical Society, 1965
milestones.description: Defines time and space complexity classes for Turing machines; generally cited as the start of systematic complexity theory.

evidence.claim: The paper is indexed with DOI 10.1090/S0002-9947-1965-0170805-7
Hartmanis and Stearns' 1965 paper is credited as the beginning of systematic complexity studies

milestones.label: Hierarchies of computations
milestones.work: Hartmanis, J.; Lewis, P. M.; Stearns, R. E., Classifications of computations by time and memory requirements, 1965
milestones.description: Classifies computations by time and memory bounds into hierarchies, matching the event's hierarchy theme.

evidence.claim: The 1965 paper with Lewis and Stearns is indexed as 1965
Hartmanis's publications include this 1965 paper with Lewis and Stearns

milestones.label: Cobham's intrinsic difficulty
milestones.work: Cobham, A., The intrinsic computational difficulty of functions, Logic, Methodology and Philosophy of Science, 1965
milestones.description: Proposes polynomial time as the robust notion of tractable computation (the Cobham-Edmonds thesis).

evidence.claim: Cobham's 'The intrinsic computational difficulty of functions' is indexed as 1965
The tractable class is identified with polynomial time, the Cobham-Edmonds thesis

milestones.note: The thesis is named after Cobham and Edmonds; the 1965 Cobham paper's content was not text-checked.

milestones.label: Blum's machine-independent measures
milestones.work: Blum, M., A machine-independent theory of the complexity of recursive functions, Journal of the ACM, 1967
milestones.description: Blum axioms for complexity measures and the speed-up theorem.

evidence.claim: Blum's machine-independent theory paper in JACM is indexed (DOI 10.1145/321386.321395)
Blum formulated axioms for complexity measures in 1967

milestones.label: Cook's theorem-proving complexity
milestones.work: Cook, S. A., The complexity of theorem-proving procedures, Proceedings of the Third ACM STOC, 1971
milestones.description: Cook's paper on theorem-proving procedures, the basis of the NP-completeness theory.

evidence.claim: Cook's 1971 paper is indexed (DOI 10.1145/800157.805047)

milestones.note: The NP-completeness content is not text-checked; the role follows the field's standard account.

milestones.description: Uses polynomial reductions among combinatorial problems, popularising NP-completeness.

milestones.note: The content (polynomial reductions) is from the title and the field's account, not text-checked.
